neighbours.label: Perception verbs 'see' and 'feel' licensed by 'can' or 'able to'
fire: From this balcony you can see the distant lighthouse.
With the new gloves I can feel the texture of the fabric.
The larger labels let everyone be able to see the prices.
After the explanation, you can feel confident about the plan.
Through the clear water we can see the stones below.
With this cushion she is able to feel comfortable at her desk.
On the enlarged chart they can see the boundary clearly.
During the exercise he can feel the muscles in his shoulders.

notes: Card peaks combine ability constructions with perception. Near misses retain the perception verb and topic but remove the ability construction. Labels use the card and top 16 corpus examples. No downloaded band scan covers this neuron. Test sentences were authored by Codex, not Bonsai.
